# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Sorcerer level 10 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Sorcerer
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5/level-6/level-7 spontaneous spell-burden
# baseline to level 8 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not
# contain derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1..level-9 fixtures, and the same
# canonical bloodline and bloodline class-skill selections (Arcane, Knowledge
# [arcana]), adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Sorcerer burden surface: no Arcane Bond
# execution, no bloodline arcana, no bonus spells/feats at 3rd+ level, no
# spellbook, no spells known, no spell slots, no spell DCs, and no
# level-11+ progression. The PF1 CRB Sorcerer class table's level-10
# "Special" column is blank — verified independently against both d20pfsrd
# and legacy.aonprd.com — like levels 2, 4, 6, and 8, so no new class feature
# is gained at 10th level (the first 5th-level spell slots arrive at 10th,
# but spell slots belong to the spontaneous spell burden that stays
# named-but-unproven); this fixture only widens the existing
# base-attack/base-save/bloodline-choice pillars.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-sorcerer-level10
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:sorcerer:10
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:17
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline:bloodline:arcane
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline_class_skill:knowledge:arcana
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
